impact: Surfaced during T-027 plan review. The session DB defaults to a cwd-relative path (REVIEW_BRIDGE_DB ?? 'reviews.db'). The MCP server opens it in the project root (its spawn cwd); the CLI runs from arbitrary directories. When cwds differ, the CLI's read-only open finds no db and fails open, so the ISS-017 cross-provider guard silently does nothing. T-027 mitigates by resolving to an absolute path, documenting that the guard is effective from the project root or with an absolute REVIEW_BRIDGE_DB, and enabling WAL + busy timeout, but does NOT relocate the db. A stable per-project or global (app-data/home) db location would make the guard cwd-independent, but that is a product decision with migration implications for existing project-local review_history — deferred here. Options: XDG/app-data dir, or walk-up to the project root to anchor the db consistently for both server and CLI.
title: CLI cross-provider guard is cwd-dependent: relative reviews.db means the guard fails open when CLI runs outside the server's cwd
